description: The index of GMM entity records, grouped by category (people, companies, institutions, places), optionally limited to one category slug — list_entity_categories has the slugs. Each record has a canonical URL, and says whether it carries a graded dossier. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

name: list_entities

coverage.description: Published stories that reference the record.

dossier.description: True when the record carries a graded dossier.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.

total.description: All matching records, not just this page.

title: List entity records
